verdict.rationale: Version, review, and rollback of configuration or automations is a fair question for an API gateway platform, so the axis applies. However, the evidence documents no first-party versioning, review workflow, or rollback feature. decK, declarative configuration, and Terraform providers are config-as-code building blocks; versioning or rolling back with them would rely on user-side tooling such as git, which earns no credit here.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can version, review, and roll back my automations
